description:
You are the course coordinator for CHEM201 Organic Chemistry I at State University. The gradebook was incorrectly configured when the course was first created — all grade items are dumped in a flat structure with the wrong aggregation method. According to the official course syllabus, the grading policy requires three weighted categories at the top level using Weighted mean of grades:
- 'Problem Sets' worth 30%: contains Problem Set 1 and Problem Set 2
- 'Lab Reports' worth 30%: contains Lab Report 1 and Lab Report 2
- 'Exams' worth 40%: contains Midterm Exam (40% within Exams) and Final Exam (60% within Exams)
Inspect the current gradebook, create the required categories, move each grade item into the correct category, set the appropriate weights, and ensure the top-level uses Weighted mean of grades aggregation. Login: admin / Admin1234!
